newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila firms buy 60,000 T wheat, 15,000 T soybean.
newsitem.headline: Manila firms buy 60,000 T wheat, 15,000 T soybean.

text.p: Philippine firms bought 60,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat and 15,000 tonnes of soybean, traders said on Friday.

Three Manila grains traders said two Philippine flour millers bought 45,000 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with 14 percent protein content at $191 per tonne C&F and around 15,000 tonnes of western white wheat at $165 per tonne C&F.
The price of the soybean, also bought from the U.S., could not be immediately determined, traders said.
Traders said the wheat orders, for April 15 to May 15 shipments, were put through a U.S.-based commodity house and a Japanese trading firm Wednesday night.
The soybean order was also coursed through the same U.S.-based commodity house.
